2026-11-06 evidence from the BenchBox migration to Theseus v0.2.x, PR #3962, judged by the v0.1.8 hunk-coverage rule:
- First head bcfd69759b: all five hosted attempts ended "absent (incomplete)", each missing 1–7 hunks.
- Head b26cbc12dd: attempt 1 was again incomplete (5 hunks unseen).
- Final head 777b323c: capture-1 covered 316/319 (three hunks in review-request.yml and review-verdict.yml unseen) before capture-2 reached 319/319 and SHIP.
- The /oracle-review comment on bcfd697 (run 42166283710) was skipped by design: "backoff: the next retry is allowed after 06:03:53Z".
So under the coverage rule, incompleteness by small margins (≤2% of hunks) is the dominant failure mode on promotion-size diffs, and backoff turns each miss into roughly an hour of delay. Calibration belongs with theseus-v021-stdin-rendered-mode-20261105 (Theseus v0.2.2): a stronger retry hint naming the unseen hunks, or a targeted follow-up read for them.
